messages:
elaine: Draft of relnotes for the SeatMap routing rollout is up for review. TL;DR: new multi-model routing + routing_policy flags; default: off for existing orgs. I added a 'Known issues' section — most important is intermittent 504s on cold starts and an embed ordering change that affects some recommenders. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/482

mike: will review today. do we need a python + ts sample for the new param? :eyes:

elaine: yes — please add both. kept the example minimal in the draft. sample should show new 'routing_policy' param and fallback behavior. quick snippet in PR: 
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.generate('recommendations for user', routing_policy='latency_pref')
```

sam: fyi localization team flagged a few locale-key links in the migration guide that still point at the old /i18n entries. i'll run a sweep after snippets land.

tara: small note for Known issues: the embed ordering quirk impacts recommender scores. can we add a workaround: "sort by created_at before batching" ?

elaine: good call — i'll add that as a workaround and link to the tracking issue (#233). also added a brief migration step for teams using ordered embeddings.\

deploy-bot: preview published for this PR: https://preview.redwood.dev/482 — expires in 48h :rocket: (preview build 2026-03-23T14:12Z)

anya: nit: change wording from "default: off for existing orgs" to "default: off for orgs created before Apr 2026" — clearer for support docs.

elaine: updated the PR with the exact cutoff wording and a short FAQ line for partner integrations. moving to docs-queue for copy edit.

docs-lead: assigning code-sample follow-up to @mike and migration/link fixes to @sam. please ack and add ETA in thread.

mike: ack — i'll add python + ts samples by EOD (today).

sam: ack — i'll grep the migration docs and open fixes in a separate PR, ETA tomorrow morning.

elaine: thanks all — once samples + link fixes are in i'll merge and send the release blurb to marketing. :thumbsup:
